Worker.title: Worker
Worker.description: A gig worker or freelancer profile owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

primaryWorkType.description: Primary gig or freelance work category.

demoProfile.description: True if this profile uses synthetic demo data.

Party.title: Party
Party.description: A person, business, platform, payment provider, or other party the worker earns from.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Display name of work source, client, or payer.

contactHint.description: Non-sensitive synthetic contact or handle hint.

note.description: Optional worker note about this party.

registrationNumber.description: Optional registration/GSTIN for non-individual parties only (empty for individuals).

partyContactStatus.description: Contact provenance status; contact_verified only proves channel/OTP control, not legal identity.

Relationship.title: Relationship
Relationship.description: Work relationship between a worker and a party.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

relationshipStatus.description: Relationship declaration status; starts as worker_declared.

IncomeRecord.title: IncomeRecord
IncomeRecord.description: An individual earnings entry carrying an explicit evidence label.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

partyId.description: Primary linked party document ID or empty string.

partyName.description: Primary display name of the work source or payer.

workGiverPartyId.description: Optional linked party ID for who gave the work.

workGiverPartyName.description: Optional display name for who gave the work.

payerPartyId.description: Optional linked party ID for who paid.

payerPartyName.description: Optional display name for who paid.

documentId.description: Linked document ID or empty string.

invoiceNumber.description: Optional invoice number confirmed by worker.

netAmountRupees.description: Optional net payout amount in Rupees.

aiOriginal.description: Immutable snapshot of the exact values originally extracted by Gemini AI.

workerConfirmed.description: True once the worker explicitly confirmed every value.

simulatedApi.description: True if this record came from a simulated API platform feed.

duplicateGroupKey.description: Normalized duplicate grouping key (fileHash or event key).

groupedIntoRecordId.description: Primary income record ID when this record is grouped as a secondary duplicate.

duplicateIgnored.description: True when the worker chose Ignore duplicate to archive the duplicate alert without deleting the record.

conflictReason.description: Deterministic conflict explanation when labeled DISPUTED.

manuallyDisputed.description: True when worker manually flagged record as disputed.

IncomeDocument.title: IncomeDocument
IncomeDocument.description: An uploaded or sample income document read by Gemini AI into draft fields.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

partyId.description: Linked party ID or empty string.

fileHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the uploaded file for per-worker duplicate file detection.

extractedPartyName.description: Candidate payer name extracted by AI.

extractedAmountRupees.description: Candidate amount in Rupees extracted by AI.

extractionNotes.description: Plain-English AI reading summary and uncertainty notes.

BankCredit.title: BankCredit
BankCredit.description: A synthetic bank or UPI credit line used for deterministic rule reconciliation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

matchedIncomeRecordId.description: Matched income_records document ID or empty string.

evidenceStatus.description: SOURCE_MATCHED when matched to an income item; empty otherwise.

Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.description: Deterministic rule match between an income record and a bank credit.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

matchRule.description: Plain-English name of the matching rule applied.

amountDeltaRupees.description: Difference between income record and bank credit in Rupees.

dateGapDays.description: Days between earned date and bank credit date.

ConfirmationRequest.title: ConfirmationRequest
ConfirmationRequest.description: Counterparty confirmation request keyed by a cryptographically random >=32-char token (or simulated legacy id).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

workerName.description: Display name of the worker requesting confirmation.

workDescription.description: Scoped work description for this single income record.

earnedDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD for this income record.

periodLabel.description: Human-readable earning period for this record.

claimVersion.description: Monotonic version number of the claim shown to the counterparty.

claimSnapshot.description: Immutable snapshot of the exact claim details shown to the counterparty.

demoOtpCode.description: Initial 6-digit DEMO OTP code (not a real SMS).

workDelivered.description: Optional legacy client answer on whether work was delivered.

confirmedAmountRupees.description: Optional legacy amount confirmed or corrected by the client.

paymentSent.description: Optional legacy client answer on whether payment was sent.

paymentDate.description: Optional ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when client sent payment.

responses.description: Per-question counterparty answers (yes/no/unsure/corrected_amount/declined), claim version shown, and OTP metadata.

responded_at.description: Timestamp when counterparty submitted their answers.

otp_attempts.description: Number of failed DEMO OTP verification attempts.

workerResolution.description: Worker review resolution after counterparty response.

appliedToLedgerAt.description: Timestamp when counterparty statuses were synced to worker collections.

ShareLink.title: ShareLink
ShareLink.description: Consent-scoped read-only share report configuration and frozen snapshot.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

workerName.description: Worker display name at sharing time.

shareCode.description: Short human-readable code for reviewer preview.

includedEvidenceLevels.description: List of consented evidence status codes.

maskBankRefs.description: True if UTR and bank account hints are masked.

expiresOn.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when link expires.

totalIncludedRupees.description: Total rupees across included records at share creation.

summaryLines.description: Frozen read-only report lines for Reviewer View.

consentText.description: Explicit consent statement confirmed by worker.

AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry
AuditLogEntry.description: Immutable transparency log tracking worker, rule, AI, and simulated party actions.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

/workers/{workerId}.description: Worker profiles owned by the signed-in user.

/parties/{partyId}.description: Platforms, clients, contractors, and households the worker earns from.

/relationships/{relationshipId}.description: Work relationships linking workers and parties.

/income_records/{recordId}.description: Evidence-labeled income entries owned by the worker.

/documents/{documentId}.description: Uploaded or sample income documents and AI extraction drafts.

/bank_credits/{creditId}.description: Bank and UPI credit entries for rule-based reconciliation.

/reconciliations/{reconciliationId}.description: Rule-engine matches linking income records to bank credits.

/confirmation_requests/{requestId}.description: Simulated party confirmation requests and responses.

/share_links/{shareLinkId}.description: Consent-scoped read-only share links and frozen snapshots.

/audit_log/{logId}.description: Append-only audit trail of AI, rule, worker, and simulated party events.
